title: Grant Writing and Tracking Workflow
description: From spotting an opportunity to logging the outcome -- and why every branch ends at the tracking spreadsheet.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club

educational.audience: First-time grant writers in a club

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a grant opportunity at any stage, the learner correctly identifies the next step in the club's grant-writing and tracking process.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover-to-preview and click-to-pin sequence with an outcome gate and two branches that converge on tracking
pedagogical.assessment: Ask what happens after an award is logged, and why that is not the end.
